# Hire: Data Analyst

## Rationale
Quarterly growth is outpacing the CEO's ability to close the loop
on pipeline metrics. An analyst focused on weekly dashboards would
free ~8 hours of CEO time per week.

## Ask
One headcount under the `research` role, monthly budget $200.
